title: Boeing 777 Maiden Flight
image_prompt: A colossal twin-engine widebody jetliner sits at the end of a runway, engines beginning to roar with heat distortion rippling from the nacelles, ground crew frozen in observation at a safe distance, the vast wings flexing slightly as the aircraft strains forward, the runway stretching to the horizon under a heavy sky, ten seconds before wheels leave the ground for the first time. Woodcut / linocut print, stark black and white, high contrast, bold carved lines, dramatic chiaroscuro, no gray midtones, no text or lettering anywhere in the image. Wide cinematic landscape composition with the key subject and all important elements inside the central band of the frame (the top and bottom 20% will be cropped away).
